newsitem.title: INDIA: CRISIL ASSIGNS 'AA+' TO ASOK LEYLAND BOND.
newsitem.headline: CRISIL ASSIGNS 'AA+' TO ASOK LEYLAND BOND.

text.p: The Credit Rating and Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday it assigned a 'AA+' rating for the new 2.5 billion rupee non-convertible bond issue of Indian truck maker Ashok Leyland Ltd.
"The rating indicates that the degree of safety with regard to timely payment of interest and principal is high," it said.
"Ashok Leyland has reported an improved performance in 1996/97 with increased sales, improvement in operating profitability as well as increased profits," CRISIL said.
